size_status: Standard pool size assumptions, not direct equipment measurements.
intrinsic_assumptions: Square pixels, principal point at image center, zero lens distortion, single constant pose per view.
split_note: Chosen before focal search. Do not use held-out balls to select focal lengths, radius, corners or model penalties.
limitations: Approximate visible boundary is not surveyed geometry
Lens distortion and principal-point crop unknown
Visual correspondences have finite annotation uncertainty
Two training and two held-out balls do not establish whole-table accuracy
